title: Vertical readiness
description: These signals come from the business's current configuration. Items needing attention are guidance and never block checkout by themselves.
noProfile: Choose a business type above to see a checklist tailored to the way this business operates.

businessCalendar.label: Business calendar
businessCalendar.hint: The saved time zone is unsupported. Update locale settings before trusting date-based readiness.

catalog.label: Sellable catalog
catalog.hint_one: {{count}} active product is available to this business.
catalog.hint_other: {{count}} active products are available to this business.

productUnits.label: Product units
productUnits.hint_one: {{count}} active product has at least one configured sales unit.
productUnits.hint_other: {{count}} active products have at least one configured sales unit.

fractionalSales.label: Fractional quantities
fractionalSales.hint_one: {{count}} product is configured for measured or cut quantities.
fractionalSales.hint_other: {{count}} products are configured for measured or cut quantities.

lotTracking.label: Lot traceability
lotTracking.hint_one: {{count}} active product requires lot-level stock handling.
lotTracking.hint_other: {{count}} active products require lot-level stock handling.

serializedInventory.label: Serialized inventory
serializedInventory.hint_one: {{count}} product preserves one physical identity per sold unit.
serializedInventory.hint_other: {{count}} products preserve one physical identity per sold unit.

weightedBarcode.label: Weight barcode scanner
weightedBarcode.hint_one: {{count}} active site scanner has valid GS1 weight or price decoding.
weightedBarcode.hint_other: {{count}} active site scanners have valid GS1 weight or price decoding.

transformationRecipes.label: Transformations and recipes
transformationRecipes.hint_one: {{count}} active recipe matches this operating profile.
transformationRecipes.hint_other: {{count}} active recipes match this operating profile.

pharmacyCatalog.label: Pharmacy catalog data
pharmacyCatalog.hint_one: {{count}} active product has a pharmaceutical profile.
pharmacyCatalog.hint_other: {{count}} active products have a pharmaceutical profile.

pharmacyPolicy.label: Effective pharmacy policy
pharmacyPolicy.hint_one: {{count}} pharmaceutical product has a sale classification allowed by the current country policy.
pharmacyPolicy.hint_other: {{count}} pharmaceutical products have a sale classification allowed by the current country policy.

restaurantTables.label: Table map

restaurantTables.hint_other: {{count}} active tables are configured for dine-in service.

kdsStations.label: Kitchen stations
kdsStations.hint_one: {{count}} active KDS station can receive routed preparation lines.
kdsStations.hint_other: {{count}} active KDS stations can receive routed preparation lines.

customerDisplay.label: Customer Display
customerDisplay.hint_zero: The customer display is not enabled.

disclaimer: These signals verify application configuration only. They do not certify legal compliance, physical hardware or a live operating pilot.
